acceptanceCriteria: Identical inputs replay the stored report and say so.
Any change to a tree, an untracked file or the check implementation misses the cache.
Entries are bounded by count or age.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1037 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem Agents run the same static checks repeatedly across many sessions over trees that have not changed, hundreds of times a day. Current workaround A wrapper keyed on the hash of both trees, the uncommitted diff, untracked files and the check scripts replays the stored report, with --fresh to bypass. Proposal Let any preflight or reference check opt into a result cache keyed on tree identities, working-tree diff and the check implementation digest. See beamfall/corvint#1037 for the full text.
title: preflight: content-keyed cache for static pre-run checks (issue #1037)
